Msg.Desc: "Error: Unable to run MATLAB engine. Please try again."
"PSpice Systems License is not available - it is required for using MATLAB functions."
"Error: COM server registration failed. Please set MATLAB path again."
"Error: Path cannot be empty. Please enter a valid path."
"Error: MATLAB does not exist at this location. Please enter a valid path."

" Perform the following steps. 1. Open command prompt (cmd) in Administrator mode 2. Go to the MATLAB bin directory which you want to switch to. (eg: R2017b/bin) 3. Run the command: matlab -regserver MATLAB displays a minimized command window. Open this window and exit MATLAB. 4. Restart PSpice and MATLAB."
